## Outcome

Describe the observable result and its evidence.

## Validation

List the behavior/contract tests run. User-facing changes include screenshots.

## Architecture decisions

If this touches trust boundaries, money/accounting, durable operational state,
privileged effects, or process lifecycle, cite the governing ADR or add one.

## Crash and concurrency analysis

Required only for control-store, ledger, reservation, command, or receipt
changes: list each crash/concurrency point moved or introduced and the test
covering it. Otherwise write “not applicable.”
